[b]Feb 27, 2025: The Currency Bill Passes[/b]
After a three day long debate into the matter of a unified standard currency between THEP, the Gøsfodde has formally passed with a majority of 100-20 the CURRENCY REORGANISATION ACT in order to begin the process of formally replacing the Lyr with the Gilder across all transactions. While the Lyr will continue to be accepted as standard currency by all state and local offices and can be used in conjunction with the Gilder, it is hoped to formally phase out the Lyr by 2027 in order to ensure the Gilder is consistently used.

[nation]United Hydronia[/nation]

[nation]United Hydronia[/nation][/quote]
[b]THE GILDER[/b]
On 25th February 2025, The great Parliamentary Assembly passed the currency amendment act 2025, which would allow for the currency to be changed. This was necessary to approve the use of the Gilder, as previously, the use of the Hydronic Dollar as the sole currency was outlined in the Hydronic Constituation. Two days later, on the 27th of February, President Zorlu approved the use of the Gilder. All government transactions are now to be made in the Gilder and the Gilder shall become the only legal currency by 27th February 2026. Many Hydronian banks have began providing services to exchange the Hydronic Dollar for the Gilder.
